title: Holding my Grandson
synopsis: Old Lady Wang’s daughter-in-law has already lost two babies. Will her daughter-in-law’s third pregnancy give her the grandson that she’s always wanted.

fullText.simplified:
一到医院，王老太太就大发脾气：“什么？还得挂号？什么叫挂号呀？生小孩来了，挂什么号？”
    王老太太气坏了，孙子可以不要，不能挂这个号！
    可是，再一看，要是不挂号，人家根本没有让你进去的意思。唉，为了孙子，只能受点委屈了。要是自己的丈夫还活着，谁会受这个委屈啊？但是没了丈夫的妇人不行，有钱也得受委屈。
    挂了号，医院要预收五十块钱。王老太太的委屈终于有了出路：“五十？五百也行，老太太我有的是钱！早说要钱不就完了，挂什么号呀？当我孙子是封信呢！”

    医生来了。一见面，王老太太气坏了！男医生！男医生当产婆？我的儿媳妇不能叫男人看了去。这还没完，又出来了两个大汉，抬起儿媳妇就往床上放。
    王老太太气得手都发抖了：“反了，反了！你们，你们这是干什么啊？那么一个年轻的孕妇，怎么能由得你们几个男人动手动脚的？你们这儿到底有没有懂事的人啊？要是有的话，叫几个女的来！不然，我们走！”
    正好遇上了个好脾气的医生，他发了话：“放下，让她们走吧！”
    医生这么一说，王老太太反倒慌了。唉！谁让孙子闹脾气不出来呢？抬吧，抬吧！
    两个大汉刚把儿媳妇抬上床，看！医生用两只手在儿媳妇的肚子上按来按去！
    王老太太看不下去了，转头看向窗外，心中大骂娘家妈：哼！你的女儿被一个男人这么按，你也不说几句！她刚要骂出来，想起孙子这十个月来都没受过一点委屈，现在被医生用手这么按来按去的，也不知道受不受得了？
    王老太太转回头，刚想开口提醒提醒医生，谁知，医生反倒先问起来了：“孕妇吃了什么东西？这么大的肚子！你们这些人也真是的！什么都给孕妇吃，吃得小孩那么大，当然生不下来了！平时也不来医院检查一下，现在生不下来了才来找我们！”他没等王老太太回答，对那两个大汉说：“抬走！”
    王老太太可从来没受过这个气！“老太太”到哪儿不是高高在上？今天竟然被骂了？这还不说，骂也要骂得对才行啊。孕妇不多吃点，怎么能生小孩呢？小孩怎么会长大呢？唉，西医都是骗人的，和他们争也没什么用，还是拿娘家妈出气吧！
    娘家妈可没打算和王老太太说话，她跟着女儿往里面走。王老太太一看，也赶忙上前去。谁知，那位医生转过身来：“这儿等着！”
    “什么？不能进去看看啊？那我们怎么知道你把儿媳妇抬到哪里去啊？是切了还是怎么样啊？”王老太太和娘家妈的眼睛都红了。
fullText.traditional:
一到醫院，王老太太就大發脾氣：“什麼？還得掛號？什麼叫掛號呀？生小孩來了，掛什麼號？”
    王老太太氣壞了，孫子可以不要，不能掛這個號！
    可是，再一看，要是不掛號，人家根本沒有讓你進去的意思。唉，為了孫子，只能受點委屈了。要是自己的丈夫還活著，誰會受這個委屈啊？但是沒了丈夫的婦人不行，有錢也得受委屈。
    掛了號，醫院要預收五十塊錢。王老太太的委屈終於有了出路：“五十？五百也行，老太太我有的是錢！早說要錢不就完了，掛什麼號呀？當我孫子是封信呢！”

    醫生來了。一見面，王老太太氣壞了！男醫生！男醫生當產婆？我的兒媳婦不能叫男人看了去。這還沒完，又出來了兩個大漢，抬起兒媳婦就往床上放。
    王老太太氣得手都發抖了：“反了，反了！你們，你們這是幹什麼啊？那麼一個年輕的孕婦，怎麼能由得你們幾個男人動手動腳的？你們這兒到底有沒有懂事的人啊？要是有的話，叫幾個女的來！不然，我們走！”
    正好遇上了個好脾氣的醫生，他發了話：“放下，讓她們走吧！”
    醫生這麼一說，王老太太反倒慌了。唉！誰讓孫子鬧脾氣不出來呢？抬吧，抬吧！
    兩個大漢剛把兒媳婦抬上床，看！醫生用兩隻手在兒媳婦的肚子上按来按去！
    王老太太看不下去了，轉頭看向窗外，心中大罵娘家媽：哼！你的女兒被一個男人這麼按，你也不說幾句！她剛要罵出來，想起孫子這十個月來都沒受過一點委屈，現在被醫生用手這麼按来按去的，也不知道受不受得了？
    王老太太轉回頭，剛想開口提醒提醒醫生，誰知，醫生反倒先問起來了：“孕婦吃了什麼東西？這麼大的肚子！你們這些人也真是的！什麼都給孕婦吃，吃得小孩那麼大，當然生不下來了！平時也不來醫院檢查一下，現在生不下來了才來找我們！”他沒等王老太太回答，對那兩個大漢說：“抬走！”
    王老太太可從來沒受過這個氣！“老太太”到哪兒不是高高在上？今天竟然被罵了？這還不說，罵也要罵得對才行啊。孕婦不多吃點，怎麼能生小孩呢？小孩怎麼會長大呢？唉，西醫都是騙人的，和他們爭也沒什麼用，還是拿娘家媽出氣吧！
    娘家媽可沒打算和王老太太說話，她跟著女兒往裡面走。王老太太一看，也趕忙上前去。誰知，那位醫生轉過身來：“這兒等著！”
    “什麼？不能進去看看啊？那我們怎麼知道你把兒媳婦抬到哪裏去啊？是切了還是怎麼樣啊？”王老太太和娘家媽的眼睛都紅了。

sentences.traditional: 他沒等王老太太回答，對那兩個大漢說：“抬走！”
sentences.pinyin: tā méi děng wáng lǎo tài tai huí dá duì nà liǎng ge dà hàn shuō tái zǒu
sentences.english: He didn’t wait for Old Lady Wang to reply, and said to the two burly men, “Carry her away!”

sentences.simplified: 王老太太可从来没受过这个气！“老太太”到哪儿不是高高在上？
sentences.traditional: 王老太太可從來沒受過這個氣！“老太太”到哪兒不是高高在上？
sentences.pinyin: wáng lǎo tài tai kě cóng lái méi shòu guò zhè ge qì lǎo tài tai dào nǎ'r bú shì gāo gāo zài shàng
sentences.english: Old Lady Wang had never been so angry! Aren’t “elderly ladies” set up on high wherever they go?

sentences.simplified: 今天竟然被骂了？这还不说，骂也要骂得对才行啊。
sentences.traditional: 今天竟然被罵了？這還不說，罵也要罵得對才行啊。
sentences.pinyin: jīn tiān jìng rán bèi mà le zhè hái bù shuō mà yě yào mà de duì cái xíng a
sentences.english: Today she was actually scolded? What’s more, if she was scolded, it should be for the right reason.

sentences.simplified: 孕妇不多吃点，怎么能生小孩呢？小孩怎么会长大呢？
sentences.traditional: 孕婦不多吃點，怎麼能生小孩呢？小孩怎麼會長大呢？
sentences.pinyin: yùn fù bù duō chī diǎn zěn me néng shēng xiǎo hái ne xiǎo hái zěn me huì zhǎng dà ne
sentences.english: If a pregnant woman doesn’t eat a lot, how can she give birth to a child? How can the child grow bigger?

sentences.simplified: 唉，西医都是骗人的，和他们争也没什么用，还是拿娘家妈出气吧！
sentences.traditional: 唉，西醫都是騙人的，和他們爭也沒什麼用，還是拿娘家媽出氣吧！
sentences.pinyin: ài xī yī dōu shì piàn rén de hé tā men zhēng yě méi shén me yòng hái shi ná niáng jia mā chū qì ba
sentences.english: Alas, doctors trained in Western medicine are all cheats. Arguing with them is useless. I had better vent to the mother!

sentences.simplified: 娘家妈可没打算和王老太太说话，她跟着女儿往里面走。
sentences.traditional: 娘家媽可沒打算和王老太太說話，她跟著女兒往裡面走。
sentences.pinyin: niáng jia mā kě méi dǎ suàn hé wáng lǎo tài tai shuō huà tā gēn zhe nǚ ér wǎng lǐ miàn zǒu
sentences.english: The mother however didn’t intend to talk to Old Lady Wang. She followed her daughter inside.

sentences.simplified: 王老太太一看，也赶忙上前去。
sentences.traditional: 王老太太一看，也趕忙上前去。
sentences.pinyin: wáng lǎo tài tai yí kàn yě gǎn máng shàng qián qù
sentences.english: As soon as Old Lady Wang saw this, she also hurried forward.

sentences.simplified: 谁知，那位医生转过身来：“这儿等着！”
sentences.traditional: 誰知，那位醫生轉過身來：“這兒等著！”
sentences.pinyin: shéi zhī nà wèi yī shēng zhuǎn guò shēn lái zhè‘r děng zhe
sentences.english: Who could have known that doctor would turn around, “Stay here!”

sentences.simplified: “什么？不能进去看看啊？那我们怎么知道你把儿媳妇抬到哪里去啊？
sentences.traditional: “什麼？不能進去看看啊？那我們怎麼知道你把兒媳婦抬到哪裏去啊？
sentences.pinyin: shén me bù néng jìn qù kàn kan a nà wǒ men zěn me zhī dào nǐ bǎ ér xí fu tái dào nǎ lǐ qù a
sentences.english: “What? I’m not allowed to go in to see? Then how will we know where you’ve taken my daughter-in-law?

sentences.simplified: 是切了还是怎么样啊？”王老太太和娘家妈的眼睛都红了。
sentences.traditional: 是切了還是怎麼樣啊？”王老太太和娘家媽的眼睛都紅了。
sentences.pinyin: shì qiē le hái shi zěn me yàng a wáng lǎo tài tai hé niáng jia mā de yǎn jing dōu hóng le
sentences.english: Will she be cut open or anything?” Both Old Lady Wang and mother had red eyes.

sentence_translations: As soon as they arrived at the hospital, Old Lady Wang threw a big tantrum, ..
.. “What? We have to register? What does registering mean? We’ve come to give birth, what are we registering for?”
Old Lady Wang was extremely angry. She could accept not having a grandson, but could not accept needing to register!
However, looking again, if you didn’t register, that meant that they simply wouldn’t let you in.
Alas, for the sake of her grandson, she had no choice but to suffer a little grievance.
If her husband were still living, who would have to suffer this grievance?
But it was no good to be a married woman who had lost her husband.
Even though she was rich, she had to suffer this grievance.
After registering, the hospital asked for an upfront payment of 50 yuan.
Old Lady Wang finally had a way out of her grievance, “50? 500 is also fine. As an elderly lady, what I have is money!
If you’d asked for money earlier it would’ve been resolved. What registration? Do you take my grandson to be a letter?”
The doctor arrived. As soon as they met, Old Lady Wang got extremely angry!
A male doctor! A male doctor as a midwife? My daughter-in-law cannot be seen by a man.
That wasn’t all. Two burly men then came out, lifting up her daughter-in-law to put her on the bed.
Old Lady Wang was so angry that her hands trembled, ..
“No, no! You, you, what are you doing? Such a young, pregnant woman, how can she be groped by you men?
Do you actually have anyone sensible here? If there are any, call some women over! If not, we’re leaving!”
Luckily, they had encountered a good-tempered doctor. He gave out the order, “Put her down, let them leave!”
When the doctor said this, Old Lady Wang instead panicked.
Alas! Who made her grandson throw a tantrum and not come out? Lift, lift!
The two burly men had just placed her daughter-in-law on the bed, and look!
The doctor put two hands on the daughter-in-law’s belly, pressing back and forth!
Old Lady Wang was unable to look anymore and turned her head to face the window.
In her heart, she cursed the daughter-in-law’s mother: ..
.. Humph! Your daughter is being pressed like this by a man and you don’t say anything!
Just as she was about to curse out loud, ..
.. she recalled that in these ten months her grandson hadn’t suffered any grievance.
Being pressed about like this by the doctor’s hands right now, who knows if the child would be able to endure it?
Old Lady Wang turned her head, ..
.. as she was about to open her mouth to remind the doctor, who could have known that the doctor would first ask, ..
.. “What has the pregnant woman eaten? Such a big belly! You people, really!
You feed everything to the pregnant woman, making the child this big. Of course it won’t come out!
You don’t come to the hospital for a check up in normal times, ..
.. and only now when the baby won’t come out do you come to see us!”
He didn’t wait for Old Lady Wang to reply, and said to the two burly men, “Carry her away!”
Old Lady Wang had never been so angry! Aren’t “elderly ladies” set up on high wherever they go?
Today she was actually scolded? What’s more, if she was scolded, it should be for the right reason.
If a pregnant woman doesn’t eat a lot, how can she give birth to a child? How can the child grow bigger?
Alas, doctors trained in Western medicine are all cheats. Arguing with them is useless. I had better vent to the mother!
The mother however didn’t intend to talk to Old Lady Wang. She followed her daughter inside.
As soon as Old Lady Wang saw this, she also hurried forward.
Who could have known that doctor would turn around, “Stay here!”
“What? I’m not allowed to go in to see? Then how will we know where you’ve taken my daughter-in-law?
Will she be cut open or anything?” Both Old Lady Wang and mother had red eyes.
